title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Terms: Holding More Than One Registry
content:
**Clause 1 — Several registries.** A customer may hold several registries of the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry for different occasions; there is no overall limit on the number of registries one customer holds.

**Clause 2 — One open registry per type.** A customer holds at most the number of registries of one registry type in active or completion status at a time that the type's schedule allows (one registry for every type). A new registry of a type is opened only when the customer holds no other registry of the same type in active or completion status. This is judged from the company's registry records for that customer and that registry type at the time of opening, not from the customer's account of them.

**Clause 3 — No restart.** A second registry for the same occasion is never opened to restart a completion period or a rewards payout.

### The open-registry test in table form

| Other registry of the same type held by the customer | Status of that other registry | One-open-registry test for a new registry of that type |
|---|---|---|
| none | — | met |
| yes | active | not met |
| yes | completion | not met |
| yes | closed | met |
| yes | cancelled | met |

A registry of a different type never counts against the test: a customer's active Wedding Registry does not count against the test for a Housewarming Registry.

### Cases (hypothetical)

- A customer whose Baby Registry closed last year opens a new Baby Registry for a second child: the earlier registry is closed, so the test is met.
- A customer whose Anniversary Registry is in its completion period asks for a second Anniversary Registry for the same anniversary so that a fresh completion period would start: the first registry is in completion status, so the test is not met, and a second registry for the same occasion is never opened for that purpose.
